content.text:
Box is added to Cursor. It is the remote server at `https://mcp.box.simular.ai/mcp`, written into `~/.cursor/mcp.json`. Your other MCP servers are still there.

Sign in once so the tools can load:

1. Open **Cursor Settings → MCP** (Tools & MCP).
2. Click **Login** next to **box**.
3. Sign in in the browser and click **Approve**. The page is [box.simular.ai/oauth/authorize](https://box.simular.ai/oauth/authorize). The defaults for which boxes the app may use, and for how long, are fine.

Then start a new chat so the box tools load.

- Watch a box live: [https://box.simular.ai/box](https://box.simular.ai/box)
- Keys and connected apps: [https://box.simular.ai/keys](https://box.simular.ai/keys)
- Support: support@simular.ai

Try one of these in the new chat:

- Use box to open Chrome, search Google for "Simular", and summarize the top 3 results.
- Use box to open GitHub Trending and tell me what today's top 3 repositories do
- Use box to go to news.ycombinator.com and give me today's top 5 stories in a table
I’ll look up how Box claims a free machine and whether the Box tools are available in this session.

hits=[]

    # skip huge caches
    base=os.path.basename(dirpath)

            hits.append((st.st_mtime, st.st_size, p))

for m,s,p in hits[:40]:
    print(int(m), s, p)
